title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono purchase Palm Beach property | 1980
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono purchased a beachfront property in Palm Beach, Florida, on 31 January 1980.

They had rented the six-bedroom property for a holiday in March and April 1979. El Solano was located at 720 South Ocean Boulevard, and was purchased for $550,000.
